headline: Quiet day before the storm; scores barely move
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Scores drifted by hundredths as earlier news faded: Libertarian Utopia and Reversion eased while Zookeeper edged up, a leftover of the Fable 5 launch two days earlier. Horizon Balance is 2.3, down 0.02.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Libertarian Utopia -0.0, Reversion -0.0 and Zookeeper +0.0 from fading.
